name: Kokuhaku Shitekita Kimoota o Futta Dake de, Yaritai Houdai Seieki Benjo ni Sareru Wake ga Nai.
original_name: 告白してきたキモヲタを振っただけで、やりたい放題精液便所にされるわけがない。
source:
How is it that she gets turned into some creepo's sex slave!?
When a cute girl on a movie set rejects the advances of a revolting otaku,
he takes her by force and lets his domination fantasy run amok! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121937.html]DLSite English[/url]]
